CheckTitle: Supabase Auth rejects passwords that appear in known data breaches
Description: **Supabase Auth** is assessed for **leaked password protection**, which checks new passwords against the HaveIBeenPwned Pwned Passwords corpus using k-anonymity before accepting them.
Risk: Users who reuse breached passwords are the first targets of **credential stuffing**; without the check, attackers can log in with lists of known credentials and reach every row the user's policies allow.

Code.Other:
1. Open the Supabase Dashboard and select the project
2. Go to Authentication > Sign In / Providers > Email (or Authentication > Policies)
3. Enable Prevent use of leaked passwords

Recommendation.Text: Enable leaked password protection together with a minimum length and character requirements.
